pr_title: 81289 - use fixed time in ESCCRRestTestCase to avoid test failures when test runs during midnight
pr_body:
`backingIndexName` was not locked to specific time previously. This may result in different (date based) data stream index names between two subsequent calls. This change is locking result to the same time. Overloaded method is added to allow multi-day testing with a time injection.

Closes #81289

I was able to reproduce this (thanks to @tlrx for the idea).
It looks like the date has changed during the test execution what resulted in a new index name.
Looks like the same issue might affect `testDataStreams_autoFollowAfterDataStreamCreated` as well.

review_comments: Issue could be demonstrated by incrementing time by additional 24h on every call.
